evidence: Mg(thd)2 (magnesium bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionate), Volatec Oy, Finland), Lithd (lithium 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionate, Strem Chemicals Inc., 98+ %, sublimed at 240 °C/0.07 mbar to densify the precursor), and TiF4 (Strem Chemicals Inc., 98%) were evaporated inside the reactor from open glass boats at 110, 180, and 130 °C, respectively.
